title: BSEB Class 9 - English Grammar
subtitle: Reported Speech
description: BSEB 9th online test containing 50 high-yield objective MCQs for Reported Speech.

questions.q: Change to Indirect Speech: He said, 'I am reading a book.'
o: He said that I am reading a book.
He says that he is reading a book.
He told he was reading a book.
He said that he was reading a book.

questions.q: Change to Indirect Speech: She said to me, 'Where are you going?'
o: She asked me where I was going.
She asked me where was I going.
She said where I was going.
She told me where I am going.

questions.q: Change to Indirect Speech: The teacher said, 'The Earth revolves around the Sun.'
o: The teacher said that the Earth revolved around the Sun.
The teacher asked if Earth revolves.
The teacher said that the Earth revolves around the Sun.
The teacher told the Earth revolves around the Sun.

questions.q: Change to Indirect Speech: He said, 'Hurrah! We have won the match.'
o: He told that they won.
He exclaimed that we have won.
He said that they won the match.
He exclaimed with joy that they had won the match.

questions.q: Change to Indirect Speech: She said, 'Do you like tea?'
o: She asked that I liked tea.
She told whether I like tea.
She asked if I liked tea.
She said if I like tea.

questions.q: Change to Indirect Speech: Ram said to Shyam, 'Please give me your pen.'
o: Ram ordered Shyam for pen.
Ram told Shyam to give pen.
Ram asked Shyam give pen.
Ram requested Shyam to give him his pen.

questions.q: Change to Indirect Speech: He said, 'I will call you tomorrow.'
o: He said that he would call me the next day.
He said that he called tomorrow.
He said that I will call tomorrow.
He told he will call next day.

questions.q: Change to Indirect Speech: 'Don't make a noise,' said the librarian.
o: The librarian told don't make noise.
The librarian said no noise.
The librarian asked to not make noise.
The librarian instructed them not to make a noise.
